items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 26.05.2025. The period is set 'ab Rechnungsdatum' (from the invoice date), an event-triggered period under §187 Abs. 1 BGB, so the day of the event (26.05.2025) is not counted; counting starts 27.05.2025. A 14-day period under §188 Abs. 1 BGB ends with the expiry of the 14th day: 27,28,29,30,31 May (5 days) + 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9 June (9 days) = 14 days, ending 09.06.2025. 09.06.2025 is a Monday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under §193 BGB is needed.
